statements.proposition: After this change, users can still pass a custom output directory with --output-path to aspire deploy (only the default changed).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Impact claim scoped to --output-path. Diff shows the --output-path option in PublishCommandBase.cs is kept; only its DefaultValueFactory method was renamed (GetDefaultOutputPath -> CreateDefaultOutputPath) and DeployCommand's default value changed. A default-value factory does not override a user-supplied value. Not executed; settled structurally. The broader default output location did change (./deploy -> .aspire/deploy/<hash>), but the statement only asserts --output-path still works.
